subject: Trial governance, evaluation checklist & kickoff cadence — Vertex Labs
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Ross <evelyn@vertexlabs.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Trial governance, evaluation checklist & kickoff cadence — Vertex Labs

Hi Evelyn —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a proposed governance/checklist so we can get the trial moving next week. High-level goals you called out:

- Improve semantic search recall for customer support queries (reduce missed matches by >= 25% measured on your feedback set).
- Reduce per-query inference cost vs your current endpoint by >= 30% while keeping reply quality at parity.
- Keep 95th-percentile latency under 350ms in our hosted config for median prompt sizes.

Proposed trial scope (two-week focused evaluation):
- Traffic slice: synthetic replay + a 5% live shadow on production search (~100k tokens/day).
- Model variants: base open model + 8-bit quantized variant; can expand if needed.
- Evaluation rubric: we attached a short spreadsheet (evaluation-rubric.xlsx) that lists acceptance criteria, sample prompts, and how we'll score quality/latency/cost.

Ownership & next steps (who does what):
- Vertex: provide a representative sample set (anonymized), confirm SSO method (Okta?), and approve DPA if required.
- Redwood: stand up trial env, implement prefix/KV caching for the search flow, provide per-route dashboards and a daily digest.
- Joint: weekly check-ins (30m) and a final readout with top metrics + recommendations.

Kickoff options: we can be ready to start the week of Jun 22 if you can provide the data snapshot by EOD Tue, Jun 16. To keep the trial tight, please confirm:
1) Which SSO option (Okta/SAML or invite-based API token) you prefer.
2) Who on your side will own data delivery (name + email).
3) Any non-negotiable security requirements (e.g., no external internet egress, on-prem-only).

I attached our trial evaluation checklist and a short network-requirements doc that lists ports and IAM roles we typically need. If that timeline works I’ll schedule the weekly 30m on Tuesdays at 10am PT and block time for an initial 60m kickoff.

Thanks — looking forward to the trial.

—
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

Attachments: evaluation-rubric.xlsx (spreadsheet), network-requirements.pdf (doc)
From: Evelyn Ross <evelyn@vertexlabs.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial governance, evaluation checklist & kickoff cadence — Vertex Labs

Marcus —

Appreciate the clear recap. This matches our internal thinking; a few clarifications from our side:

- Success criteria: we'll formally sign off on the evaluation spreadsheet, but please add an explicit precision/recall row for the labeled support tickets slice (we care more about recall improvements for long-tail queries).
- SSO: Okta is preferred; we can also do invite-based tokens for the short trial if it's quicker.
- Data delivery: I will own the sample and will loop in our data engineer (Samir) — his email is samir@vertexlabs.com. Expect the anonymized snapshot by end of day Mon, Jun 15.
- Security/legal: our procurement team will request your SOC 2 Type II report and a short DPA. Can you point us to those assets?

We like the Jun 22 start as a target. Weekly Tuesdays at 10am PT works for our calendar.

One more ask — during the trial we’ll need a simple failback/fallback procedure spelled out in case results cause regressions to customer facing search. Can your SE draft a runbook?

Thanks,
Evelyn
VP Product, Vertex Labs
Evelyn.Ross@vertexlabs.com

> On Jun 12, 2026, at 09:15, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com> wrote:
> > Thanks again for the call this morning... (see above)
From: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Ross <evelyn@vertexlabs.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 14:28:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Trial governance, evaluation checklist & kickoff cadence — Vertex Labs

Hi Evelyn / Marcus —

Thanks for the details — I pulled together a short technical plan and a minimal runbook for the failback scenario. Highlights:

- Runbook (short):
  1) If quality metric drop > 10% vs baseline for the labeled slice, switch routing back to your existing endpoint (we'll provide a toggle in the routing policy).
  2) Use cached stable responses for top-50 queries while we investigate.
  3) Roll back model variant to unquantized baseline if hallucination rate increases > 5%.

- Network/IAM notes: we only need outbound HTTPS to our control plane, and a single inbound port (443) for the traffic proxy. We'll provide an IAM role with limited scope to manage keys; the network-requirements.pdf has the specifics.
- Okta: we can support SAML SSO for dashboards; for the trial invite-based API token is often faster.

I attached a tiny sample script (sample-ingest-script.py) you can run against an anonymized bucket to validate the pipeline.

I’ll prep the runbook as a lightweight Confluence page before kickoff and share it in the drive link.

—
Ava Chen
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ava@redwood.com

Attachments: sample-ingest-script.py (text)

Evelyn —

Quick nudge as we prep for the targeted Jun 22 kickoff. Per our timeline:
- Data snapshot due (Vertex -> Redwood): EOD Mon, Jun 15 (you noted Samir would provide).
- Redwood: standing by to validate ingest and share the Confluence runbook by Tue morning.
- Legal: we shared the SOC 2 link in the HubSpot record and can provision a redacted DPA for signature.

If the snapshot is delayed we can shift the kickoff one week; otherwise I’m holding Tue Jun 22 10:00am PT on calendars for a 60m kickoff. Can you confirm Samir has the task and your legal team has what they need?

Thanks — want to make sure we avoid a mid-week scramble.

—
Marcus
